d:
Women from across Maharashtra gathered at Mumbai's Azad Maidan to protest delays in the disbursal of benefits under the Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana.
Participants demanded the immediate release of pending instalments, restoration of payments for beneficiaries who had completed e-KYC, and fulfillment of promises made during the election campaign. Many women said the financial assistance helped them manage rising costs of food, fuel, medicines and education.
Thank you for watching our video!
